subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures be suppressed before mutating/detail handling, or should current cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail warnings remain visible and the linked issue be narrowed?
rationale: Current tests intentionally surface some exec detail-mode warnings, while this PR asserts exec-like warnings should always be hidden; choosing the permanent user-visible warning contract is a maintainer product decision.

options.title: Clarify And Revise Policy
options.body: Define the intended exec-like warning behavior first, then update the policy ordering and regression tests to match it before merge.

options.title: Preserve Detail Warnings
options.body: Keep the existing cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose warnings visible and narrow or close the linked behavior request instead of merging this suppress-all change.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Leave the PR open but unmerged until contributor proof and maintainer policy direction are available.

recommendation.title: Clarify And Revise Policy
recommendation.body: Define the intended exec-like warning behavior first, then update the policy ordering and regression tests to match it before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and current blame place this handle on the central warning-policy and mutation-helper surfaces.
